recipe.name: Açaí Bowl
directions: Blend the base: Break up the frozen açaí packet and banana into chunks to help them blend more easily. Add the açaí, banana, frozen berries, ¼ cup plant-based milk, nut butter (if using), and maple syrup or agave (if using) to a blender or food processor. Blend until smooth and thick, using a tamper or pausing to scrape down the sides as needed. Add more milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, only as needed, the goal is a thick, spoonable texture.
Assemble: Scoop the smoothie mixture into a bowl, add your favorite toppings, and serve right away.

ingredients.name: Mixed Frozen Berries
ingredients.notes: or use a single berry like strawberry, raspberry, blueberry, or cherry
